title: a worker build without a budget mapping validates: build validate prints ok and exits 0
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, the v0.1.0 cut (budget is optional on every build)
intent: A build with no `budget` key is valid on every tier. `build validate no-budget` prints its ok line and the summary, exits 0, prints nothing on stderr and never calls orca. The file is a complete worker build that differs from a normal one only in having no budget.

stdout.equals:
ok no-budget repo jitso/builds/no-budget.yaml
checked 1 builds: 1 ok, 0 invalid
